matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the density compensation formula in Section 3.2.1 where multiplying by √ρ contradicts the goal of penalizing high-density regions. Neither finding addresses this defect; pred_id 1 discusses hypersphere geometry in 3.2.2, and pred_id 2 discusses loss functions in Section 3.3.

GT2 concerns the contradiction about whether boundary features are noisy or informative in the hypersphere fusion strategy. Pred_id 1 identifies a different mathematical error in the hypersphere constraint formulation (linear vs. squared distance), not the conceptual contradiction about feature quality. This is a different defect in the same section (R1 violation).

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies a legitimate mathematical error in the hypersphere constraint formulation that is not in the ground truth.
Identifies a legitimate issue with undefined logarithms in the loss functions that is not in the ground truth.
